title: Affine-to-global lifting for universal first order thickenings
statement: For h : Z ⟶ X and i : Z ⟶ Z', h' : Z' ⟶ X, if i is a first order thickening, i ≫ h' = h, and the universal lifting property holds whenever both test schemes are affine, then IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening h i h'.

proof.text: Cover an arbitrary test target by affine opens, apply the affine lifting property, glue the local morphisms, and use affine uniqueness on overlaps.

lean.statement: theorem isUniversalFirstOrderThickening_of_affine_local {Z X Z' : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ X) (i : Z ⟶ Z') (h' : Z' ⟶ X) (hi : IsFirstOrderThickening i) (hcomp : i ≫ h' = h) (haffine : ∀ {T T' : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine T] [IsAffine T'] (j : T ⟶ T') (b : T' ⟶ X) (a : T ⟶ Z), IsFirstOrderThickening j → j ≫ b = a ≫ h → ∃! a' : T' ⟶ Z', a' ≫ h' = b ∧ j ≫ a' = a ≫ i) : IsUniversalFirstOrderThickening h i h'
